ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure (a) is a control system block diagram with two negative feedbacks. The input X enters the first summing point and is subtracted by the negative feedback returned from the output Y; afterward it passes through gain K1. The second summing point takes the K1 output as the positive input and subtracts the node signal located between the two modules 1/(s-30) and 1/(s+3); afterward it passes through gain K2, then sequentially passes through 1/(s-30) and 1/(s+3), obtaining the output Y. Figure (b) is the logarithmic-coordinate magnitude-frequency curve of |H(jω)|: ω goes from 1 to 100, the magnitude is about 1 at low frequency, the peak value near ω≈10 is about 3, and near ω=100 is about 0.01. Then reason: Let z be the signal between 1/(s-30) and 1/(s+3). From the block diagram, one can write e1 = X - Y, e2 = K1 e1 - z, z = K2 e2/(s-30), Y = z/(s+3). Eliminating e1, e2, z gives H(s)=Y/X=K1K2 / ((s+3)(s-30+K2)+K1K2). Let N=K1K2, then H(s)=N / ((s+3)(s-30+K2)+N). From the high-frequency point in the figure |H(j100)|≈0.01, and the second-order system high-frequency approximation |H(jω)|≈N/ω^2, so N≈0.01*100^2=100. For s=j10, |H(j10)| = N / sqrt((3(K2-30)+N-100)^2 + 100(K2-27)^2). Substituting the peak value in the figure |H(j10)|≈3 and N=100 gives 3 = 100 / sqrt((3(K2-30))^2 + 100(K2-27)^2). Solving gives two approximate roots K2≈24.2 or K2≈30.3. According to the low-frequency magnitude in the figure being close to 1, and choosing positive damping K2>27, take K2≈30.3. Thus K1=N/K2≈100/30.3≈3.3, which to one decimal place is 3.3.

Eliminate e1,e2,z to obtain H(s)=K1K2/[(s+3)(s-30+K2)+K1K2]. Let N=K1K2. From the plotted high-frequency point |H(j100)|≈0.01 and the second-order rolloff, set N≈100. Then evaluate |H(j10)|=N/sqrt((3(K2-30)+N-100)^2+100(K2-27)^2) and set it equal to the plotted peak value around 3. 先描述图像：图(a)是一个带两条负反馈的控制系统框图。输入 X 进入第一个求和点，与从输出 Y 返回的负反馈相减；随后经过增益 K1。第二个求和点把 K1 输出作为正输入，并减去位于 1/(s-30) 与 1/(s+3) 两个模块之间的节点信号；随后经过增益 K2，再依次经过 1/(s-30) 和 1/(s+3)，得到输出 Y。图(b)是 |H(jω)| 的对数坐标幅频曲线：ω 从 1 到 100，幅值在低频约为 1，在 ω≈10 附近峰值约为 3，在 ω=100 附近约为 0.01。
再推理：令 z 为 1/(s-30) 与 1/(s+3) 之间的信号。由框图可写出 e1 = X - Y，e2 = K1 e1 - z，z = K2 e2/(s-30)，Y = z/(s+3)。消去 e1、e2、z 得到 H(s)=Y/X=K1K2 / ((s+3)(s-30+K2)+K1K2)。令 N=K1K2，则 H(s)=N / ((s+3)(s-30+K2)+N)。由图中高频点 |H(j100)|≈0.01，且二阶系统高频近似 |H(jω)|≈N/ω^2，所以 N≈0.01*100^2=100。对 s=j10，有 |H(j10)| = N / sqrt((3(K2-30)+N-100)^2 + 100(K2-27)^2)。将图中峰值 |H(j10)|≈3 和 N=100 代入，得到 3 = 100 / sqrt((3(K2-30))^2 + 100(K2-27)^2)。解得两个近似根 K2≈24.2 或 K2≈30.3。根据图中低频幅值接近 1，并且选择正阻尼 K2>27，取 K2≈30.3。于是 K1=N/K2≈100/30.3≈3.3，按一位小数为 3.3。

The second summing point takes the K1 output as the positive input and subtracts the node signal located between the two modules 1/(s-30) and 1/(s+3); afterward it passes through gain K2, then sequentially passes through 1/(s-30) and 1/(s+3), obtaining the output Y. Figure (b) is the logarithmic-coordinate magnitude-frequency curve of |H(jω)|: ω goes from 1 to 100, the magnitude is about 1 at low frequency, the peak value near ω≈10 is about 3, and near ω=100 is about 0.01.
Then reason: Let z be the signal between 1/(s-30) and 1/(s+3). From the block diagram, one can write e1 = X - Y, e2 = K1 e1 - z, z = K2 e2/(s-30), Y = z/(s+3). Eliminating e1, e2, z gives H(s)=Y/X=K1K2 / ((s+3)(s-30+K2)+K1K2). Let N=K1K2, then H(s)=N / ((s+3)(s-30+K2)+N). From the high-frequency point in the figure |H(j100)|≈0.01, and the second-order system high-frequency approximation |H(jω)|≈N/ω^2, so N≈0.01*100^2=100. For s=j10, |H(j10)| = N / sqrt((3(K2-30)+N-100)^2 + 100(K2-27)^2). Substituting the peak value in the figure |H(j10)|≈3 and N=100 gives 3 = 100 / sqrt((3(K2-30))^2 + 100(K2-27)^2). Solving gives two approximate roots K2≈24.2 or K2≈30.3. According to the low-frequency magnitude in the figure being close to 1, and choosing positive damping K2>27, take K2≈30.3. Thus K1=N/K2≈100/30.3≈3.3, which to one decimal place is 3.3.
